S1E1. Young restaurateur Archie McDonald is tricked into returning to Glenbogle by his eccentric parents, Hector and Molly, and finds the estate is on the verge of bankruptcy.
S1E2. A ruthless banker informs the family that if they can't pay the outstanding debt, the bank will close Glenbogle. Desperate to save his home, Archie pulls out all the stops.
S1E3. Archie's girlfriend and business partner, Justine, has arrived from London to find out what he is up to while Killwillie asks the family to host the Glenbogle ball in his place.
S1E4. A genealogist comes to Glenbogle looking for the rightful heir to the Ballantine clan. Meanwhile, he reveals a secret tie between the MacDonald family and Katrina.
S1E5. Archie's sister Lizzie turns up with her boyfriend and a group of massage therapists intent on turning Glenbogle into a healing centre, meanwhile Golly goes missing.
S8E20. A Faraway Cry: Caroline travels to an influenza-ridden mining camp with Dr Baker after she receives a plea for help from an old friend who is pregnant and desperately ill.
S8E21. He Was Only Twelve: Part 1: During a trip to Sleepy Eye, James and Albert walk into a bank robbery. James is critically wounded, and the doctor tells James is expected to die. Part 1 of 2.
S8E22. He Was Only Twelve: Part 2: Charles, unable to deal with the mounting pressure concerning his son's critical condition, becomes verbally abusive to his family and friends. Part 2 of 2.
S9E1. Times Are Changing: Part 1: Having suffered hard times and wanting to find a better life, the Ingalls family move to the city, selling their land to the Carter family. Part 1 of 2.
S9E2. Times Are Changing: Part 2: Almanzo's brother Royal reveals he has a serious heart condition and sadly passes away. Jenny blames Laura for his death and feels she can't go on. Part 2 of 2.
S9E3. Welcome To Olesonville: Mrs Oleson finds some old Walnut Grove bonds and promises not to cash them in if the town elects her as mayor! The townsfolk fight back with their own candidate.
S9E4. Rage: Mr Stark is denied a bank loan; this sends him over the edge, and he shoots his wife and daughter. He hides in Laura's house, convinced that she and Jenny are his wife and daughter.
S3E19. Aid Station: Hawkeye, Margaret and Klinger are sent to a frontline aid station under heavy fire to fill in for a dead surgeon.
S3E20. Love and Marriage: Frank blames a young Korean assistant, Mr Kwan, for his mistakes in the OR. Hawkeye and Trapper befriend Kwan and try to reunite him with his pregnant wife.
S3E21. Big Mac: The camp prepares for a visit from General Douglas MacArthur, but not all personnel are excited; Klinger, in his drag, is told to keep out of sight.
S3E22. Payday: Hawkeye has been given the job of acting paymaster. When the job is done, Hawkeye slips Radar a left over 10 dollars which prompts the wrath of a zealous payroll clerk.
S1E2. When Whicher offers to help a country lady find her niece, he's drawn into a disturbing murder case that pits him against wealthy, powerful figures and his former police colleagues.
